title: WorkspaceDelivered@1
description: The Task a `delivered` Workspace was made from (ADR-0158 clause 7), recorded as data right after its `WorkspaceRegistered@1`, apart from its label, which carries a suffix when the Task ID was already a label. The Storage Budget never collects that Task while the Workspace stays registered (ADR-0144). No host path.

task_id.description: The delivered Task's ID: the safe-name rule of Task IDs.
